225 template<typename T>
226 const T* get_option( const char* name, Sint32& return_code)
227 {
228 const base::IInterface* pointer = 0;
229 return_code = get_option( name, &pointer);
230 if( return_code != 0 || !pointer)
231 return 0;
232
233 base::Handle<const base::IInterface> handle( pointer);
234 const T* pointer_T = pointer->get_interface<T>();
235 if( !pointer_T) {
236 return_code = -2;
237 return 0;
238 }
239
240 return pointer_T;
241 }
